title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani confides in Anbu about her suspicion of Vennila's involvement in their family troubles. Elsewhere, Rajasekar's growing affection for Sivagami infuriates Rajeshwari.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kumaresan and Ganthimathi shock everyone by withdrawing the case against Kalamma in Ashok's murder. Paraman and Ilamathi are later stunned to hear about their unexpected decision.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Prabhakaran praises Vetri's bravery in saving Abinaya while Vetri promises Sudar to stay by her side forever. Later, Divya consoles Swetha and her mother over Karna's crime.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi celebrates Azhagar and Poongodi's victory with his family. Later, the villagers express disappointment as the eagerly awaited cultural dance show fails to impress them.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Shruthi rejects marriage, but Lakshmi advises her to accept it happily. Meanwhile, Bagyaraj checks on Revathi, and Thangaraj bans the fake dietitian's menu from their home.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel halts Saravanan's secret marriage plan with Anjali, urging him to wait until Thangamayil gives birth. Gomathi boasts after securing her share of her parental property.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Vannathi refuses to marry Pandian, leaving him upset. Chozhan recalls his family joining his honeymoon with Nila and insists on joining Cheran and Chandayatha's movie outing.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sathya asks Chandra to live in Rekha's flat, so Chandra invites Meena and Muthu over. Meanwhile, Manoj and Sakthivel hunt for Kanaga's lost ring.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Karuppu sets aside his sorrow and delights the family by appearing as Lord Vinayagar. Meanwhile, Tamizhselvi surprises everyone with a new car and hands Karuppu the keys to drive.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun warns Aadhavan about Karikalan. Later, Aadhavan tells Pooja that Arjun spotted them, and Pooja demands he marry her publicly to secure her happiness.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy sternly warns Indhira not to get involved in the matter again. Hurt by his confrontation, Indhira finds solace when Murugan vows to expose the QR fraud.
